caption:
From an idea to a working design draft—without starting from a blank canvas.

Claude Design is Anthropic's beta workspace for creating prototypes, wireframes, pitch decks, and visual assets from a description.

What caught my attention is the workflow: bring in an existing design system from GitHub or a local codebase, adjust elements directly, then hand the work over to Claude Code or connected tools.

For product teams and developers, that could shorten the journey from a rough concept to something people can review and build on. It doesn't replace thoughtful design decisions, but it can make early exploration faster.

Claude Design is currently listed for Pro, Max, Team, and Enterprise plans.

Source: https://claude.com/product/design
